title: MRAG-Suite: A Cross-Domain Diagnostic Benchmark and Tooling for Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's disproportionate reliance on either textual or visual evidence by calculating the differences in claim recall and context precision across modalities (ΔCR, ΔCP), measuring Cross-Modal Agreement (CMA), and tracking modality-attributed hallucination rates.

Comparing model accuracy, claim recall, and hallucination rates on a curated 200-query ambiguity subset versus a matched set of clear queries to measure the model's tendency to commit to only one reasonable sense of an underspecified prompt.
